answer: In an agent market trading saffron, violet dye, and ridge maps, each identity must lock 100 tokens for 30 days to receive one bidding slot per hour. Creating more names grants no extra slots unless each name posts its own bond. An attacker seeking 1,000 identities must therefore immobilize 100,000 tokens for a month, paying the financing or opportunity cost. The rule makes influence scale with committed capital, so identities alone are useless.
